description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%9A%A8%EC%A0%95%EC%9D%98-%EB%B0%9C%ED%99%94%EC%A0%90/2793), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/59624180)

The word "first" carries a sense of excitement.
A feeling experienced for the first time, a journey taken for the first time, a food tasted for the first time.
For Hyojung, "first" isn't something grand.
Rather, it's something indifferent.

Though it was her first day of high school,
for Hyojung, it was a day when she didn't want to care about anything,
a day when she just wanted to go home.
Even to Hyojung, new friends naturally approach,
but opening her heart isn't easy for her.

Amidst this, a story reaches Hyojung's ears.
The subject is a quiet, reserved child in her class.
That child's name is Ha-an.

A grim rumor follows Ha-an:
someone refused his confession,
so Ha-an set something on fire.
Hyojeong draws a line, dismissing it as none of her concern.
But life never flows according to one's intentions.

After witnessing a peculiar scene,
Hyojeong finds herself unable to ignore Ha-an.

Hyojeong saw it.
The flames rising from Ha-an's body...
